Transparent background, no checkerboard, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow halo, text, lettering, labels, logo, watermark, border, costume, held objects or extra creatures. Body glow must stay inside its contour. Avoid human forms and recognizable existing characters.

Body and exact anatomy: One rounded porous tuff-stone body. Exactly three gently curved shallow grooves offset across the upper surface. Exactly four broad short feet, all countable. Exactly two small simple dark eyes together on the image-right front, no mouth. No branches, arms, cross shape, or separate head.

Keep every declared part clearly countable; do not add other parts. This must be one full-body sprite only.

Input image 1 is the exact corrected normal illustration identity reference. Redraw this SAME creature as deliberate authentic game pixel art. Change only the rendering medium. Never downsample, pixelation-filter or redesign the creature.
